reasons: Directionally correct: Corio (our client, the paying licensee) receives a 60-day renewal reminder from Commerce One and a cap on renewal fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%, exactly the two preferred-position elements missing from Section 11.1.

Deviation classification is justified — the clause already satisfies the 12-month renewal term and 30-day opt-out, but has no reminder obligation and Exhibit B leaves 'Year 2-5, and beyond' maintenance fees uncapped.

Edit is additive only; no existing rights (including the favorable 30-day notice window) were altered or weakened, and the 5-year period is an initial term, not a multi-year automatic renewal, so the walk-away trigger is not implicated.
Failed 'notice window ≤ 60 days' check is a regex phrasing artifact — the retained sentence expressly provides 'at least thirty (30) days prior', which meets the preferred position.
High changed-character ratio (0.913) reflects two appended sentences on a short clause rather than an unnecessary rewrite; the original text is preserved verbatim.
Comment is accurate, concise, correctly attributed to the playbook, and offers the 5% fallback as instructed.
